page.notes: Printing is heavily broken and speckled; many Hebrew vowel points and several Latin words are doubtful. Right column top line "latæ copiæ" is set in the upper part of the column and the Hebrew before it is illegible. Entries in the left column after "vexil-" and the right column's final "ex-" run over the column break and are left as printed. Several Hebrew forms are partly unreadable and transcribed as closely as the scan allows; no [?] markers applied where the letters could not be confirmed, so treat the Hebrew with caution.
